title: Optimization outcome memory
objective: Implement the durable v2 outcome ledger, canonical NDJSON/SQLite query CLI, Campaign 1 anchor, current-memory report, and focused regression tests

oracles: Canonical ledger round trip and exact current Campaign 1 anchor

handoff.summary: Implemented an exact, content-addressed v2 optimization-memory record and context model, canonical sorted NDJSON authority with a derived indexed SQLite query view, build/query/report/check CLI commands, explicit current/predecessor-compatible/historical/invalid actionability, source-subject lineage, prior-negative mechanism linkage, accepted-outcome disappearance/regression alerts, and focused regression tests. Git commit and tree identities are diagnostic only: actionability requires reviewed source-closure, workload, opportunity, and subject-lineage identities plus complete evidence provenance. The checked Campaign 1 anchor binds its exact v1 receipt, producer command, immutable release, source region, compiler pass/lowering mechanism, fallback, revision, epoch, and regression state; it remains visible but deliberately historical and nonactionable instead of being misrepresented as v2 authority.
risks: The checked current-memory report contains only the frozen Campaign 1 historical anchor; Campaign 2 must add its actual v2 outcome record and new epoch context during integration.

Repository-wide build, compiler, and architecture gates are intentionally left to the integration lane so this evidence-only lane does not duplicate the shared epoch build. The focused memory and evidence-store suites pass.

The SQLite file is derived and intentionally has a physical digest distinct from the canonical NDJSON logical identity; consumers must verify the round trip rather than treating SQLite bytes as authority.
next_steps: Add the selected Campaign 2 v2 outcome and durable rejection records with exact intervention mechanisms, evidence digests, fallback identities, and subject predecessor links.
Generate the integrated current epoch context and current-memory report, then run the CLI check in shared CI or the package-level integration script.
Publish the canonical NDJSON and derived SQLite gzip assets under the logical ledger identity when the integrated campaign evidence is frozen.
